unit: Baseline menu-action proposal hazard per model-unit hour, before expression/context multipliers, state/target gates and runtime modifiers; not a measured count of committed events.
step_probability: K=sum(k_a*m_a); p_a=(1-exp(-K*dt))*k_a*m_a/K; REST=exp(-K*dt); gates applied before conversion
review_status: DRAFT — SCIENTIFIC AUDIT RECORDED; NOT VALIDATED. All numerical rates and beta defaults remain assumed; source identity verification is not parameter calibration.

confidence_levels.order_of_magnitude: Reserved for quantitatively justified bounds with matching event/exposure definitions; no current default row qualifies.
confidence_levels.assumed: Declared numerical modelling assumption; no direct estimate matching the runtime event and supplied dataset is established, even when related literature exists.
confidence_levels.measured: Direct estimate for the same dataset and experimental conditions; no default rows currently qualify.

ctl_serial_killing.citation: Halle S et al. In vivo killing capacity of cytotoxic T cells is limited and involves dynamic interactions and T cell cooperativity. Immunity 2016;44:233-245.
ctl_serial_killing.summary: Imaging/model estimates span 2-16 infected targets per CTL per day. This is not a conditional menu-action hazard or an NK measurement.
ctl_serial_killing.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
ctl_serial_killing.accessed_material: PMC full text; Summary and Discussion.
ctl_serial_killing.numerical_rate_verification: not established for the default model parameter; quantitative calibration remains pending
ctl_serial_killing.measured_endpoint: Virus-infected targets killed per CTL per day, with heterogeneous and cooperative killing.

ctl_killing_adoptive.citation: Breart B et al. Two-photon imaging of intratumoral CD8+ T cell cytotoxic activity during adoptive T cell therapy in mice. J Clin Invest 2008;118:1390-1397.
ctl_killing_adoptive.summary: Approximately one target per six hours of cumulative interaction, not a directly measured unconditional waiting time. No NK calibration.
ctl_killing_adoptive.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
ctl_killing_adoptive.accessed_material: Publisher full text; Figure 5 and Methods.
ctl_killing_adoptive.numerical_rate_verification: not established for the default model parameter; quantitative calibration remains pending
ctl_killing_adoptive.experimental_system: Mouse EG7 tumour; activated OT-I CD8 adoptive transfer
ctl_killing_adoptive.measured_endpoint: Tumour apoptosis events divided by cumulative CTL-target interaction time.

cd8_expansion.citation: Murali-Krishna K et al. Counting antigen-specific CD8 T cells: a reevaluation of bystander activation during viral infection. Immunity 1998;8:177-187.
cd8_expansion.summary: Expansion counts do not separately identify individual division, death and migration; the earlier 6-8 h rate description is unsupported here.
cd8_expansion.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
cd8_expansion.accessed_material: PubMed primary-article abstract; publisher full text not accessed.
cd8_expansion.numerical_rate_verification: not established for the default model parameter; quantitative calibration remains pending
cd8_expansion.experimental_system: Mouse acute LCMV infection; antigen-specific CD8 cells

cd8_cycle_time.citation: Yoon H, Kim TS, Braciale TJ. The cell cycle time of CD8+ T cells responding in vivo is controlled by the type of antigenic stimulus. PLoS One 2010;5:e15423.
cd8_cycle_time.summary: Initial proliferative cycles can approach 2 h after a much longer activation-to-proliferation delay; stimulus and division history matter. Not an NK rate.
cd8_cycle_time.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
cd8_cycle_time.accessed_material: Publisher full text; Results/Figure 1 and Discussion.

cd8_cycle_time.experimental_system: Murine antigen-specific CD8 cells; influenza/vaccinia or vaccination
cd8_cycle_time.measured_endpoint: CFSE-derived early division timing after proliferation begins.

melanoma_ki67.citation: Gimotty PA et al. Biologic and prognostic significance of dermal Ki67 expression, mitoses, and tumorigenicity in thin invasive cutaneous melanoma. J Clin Oncol 2005;23:8048-8056.
melanoma_ki67.summary: A marker/prognosis association does not estimate a per-cell hourly division hazard; no Ki67-to-rate conversion is justified by this anchor alone.
melanoma_ki67.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.

exhaustion_timescale.citation: Wherry EJ et al. Viral persistence alters CD8 T-cell immunodominance and tissue distribution and results in distinct stages of functional impairment. J Virol 2003;77:4911-4927.
exhaustion_timescale.summary: Different functions deteriorate at different times; this does not estimate a single binary EXHAUST waiting-time hazard, recovery cutoff, or CD4/Treg/NK rate.
exhaustion_timescale.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
exhaustion_timescale.accessed_material: Publisher indexed full-text Results; functional impairment and cytotoxicity sections.

exhaustion_timescale.experimental_system: Mouse chronic versus acute LCMV; epitope-specific CD8 cells
exhaustion_timescale.measured_endpoint: Progressive loss of cytokine and cytolytic functions, including population deletion.

epidermal_turnover.citation: Halprin KM. Epidermal 'turnover time' - a re-examination. Br J Dermatol 1972;86:14-19.
epidermal_turnover.summary: The review discusses surface transit/renewal, not a basal-cell division hazard or melanocyte kinetics. The earlier 200-300 h cycle claim remains unsupported.
epidermal_turnover.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
epidermal_turnover.accessed_material: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; full text not accessed.
epidermal_turnover.numerical_rate_verification: not established for the default model parameter; quantitative calibration remains pending
epidermal_turnover.experimental_system: Literature on normal and psoriatic epidermal renewal
epidermal_turnover.measured_endpoint: Time from cell formation to arrival at the epidermal surface.

endothelial_turnover.citation: Hobson B, Denekamp J. Endothelial proliferation in tumours and normal tissues: continuous labelling studies. Br J Cancer 1984;49:405-413.
endothelial_turnover.summary: Tumour potential doubling spans 2.4-13 days; normal turnover estimates span 47-23000 days. Neither endpoint directly calibrates the default human endothelial hazard.
endothelial_turnover.verification: Source identity and stated endpoint checked 2026-11-02; numerical mapping to this runtime is not validated.
endothelial_turnover.accessed_material: PubMed primary abstract and PMC indexed Results; no new fitted rate extraction.
endothelial_turnover.numerical_rate_verification: not established for the default model parameter; quantitative calibration remains pending
endothelial_turnover.experimental_system: Five experimental mouse tumours, placenta and normal tissues
endothelial_turnover.measured_endpoint: Continuous thymidine labelling: potential doubling and normal turnover estimates.

anchor_verification_policy: bibliography_verified concerns identity only. verify=true retains unresolved quantitative transfer or calibration. Seven anchors are primary research and epidermal_turnover is a review; no cited endpoint is a fitted default hazard.

audit.scope: Source-to-event and runtime semantics; metadata correction only
audit.annotation_requirement: Existing object labels accepted; no new H&E or manual review required.

model_unit.cell_agent_segmented_cell: one supplied segmented-cell agent; identity/segmentation not independently certified
model_unit.cell_agent_nucleus: one supplied nucleus used as a cell proxy; not evidence that nucleus transitions equal whole-cell kinetics
model_unit.lattice_binned_spot: one occupied fixed bin; rates are not multiplied by occupancy or converted into per-cell hazards

runtime_contract.conversion: Local effective hazards are converted by first-event competing risks after available-action gates. At most one menu action is sampled per unit per step; ongoing motion and implicit clocks may also act.
modifier_order: packaged baseline or explicit context.action_priors override
signature-derived beta multiplier and declared context modifiers
runtime state/target gates, ACTIVATE signal ratio and PROLIFERATE density factor
optional Jev pooling and seeded action draw
synchronous commit, conflicts/capacity and implicit clocks
runtime_contract.proposal_vs_commit: Target conflicts, same-round death and capacity limits can prevent a sampled proposal from producing its nominal outcome. Mean baseline hazard is not a measured population event rate.
runtime_contract.jev: Jev pooling changes the final action distribution. Hidden prior uses alpha=1; this table does not calibrate its time scale.

separate_clocks.activation: ACTIVATE samples/renews an exponential lifetime using dynamics.activation_half_life_hours; DEACTIVATE is implicit at a commit boundary.
separate_clocks.exhaustion: EXHAUST sets exhausted_since. RECOVER is disabled after dynamics.terminal_exhaustion_hours; this does not disable every other action.
separate_clocks.corpse: APOPTOSIS/KILL create a cell-agent corpse. CLEAR_CORPSE or dynamics.corpse_lifetime_hours removes it; lattice bins have no cell corpses.
separate_clocks.movement: MOVE starts or renews an episode; speed_um_per_hour and persistence_hours independently determine displacement and mean episode duration.
separate_clocks.signals: Each SECRETE adds one abstract signal unit; signal_half_life_hours sets decay. Neither is a measured molecular concentration.

runtime_contract.parameter_scope: Default rows are reused across organisms/tissues unless explicitly overridden. Existing tissue profiles do not establish sample-specific rate calibration.

PROLIFERATE.event: Attempt one daughter agent, keeping the parent alive and inheriting baseline evidence/state clocks.
PROLIFERATE.eligible_state: Requires declared proliferation permission. T_CD8 additionally requires activation; no universal activation gate for NK, T_CD4 or T_reg. Exhaustion alone does not block division.
PROLIFERATE.runtime_modifier: In the cell-agent kernel multiply by max(0,1-local_live_neighbors/n_max); population cap can block commit.
PROLIFERATE.lattice: Add division_increment to one compatible neighboring fixed bin with capacity; not a new cell/bin.

ACTIVATE.event: Set or renew an abstract activated state and its exponential lifetime.
ACTIVATE.eligible_state: Permitted living units, including already activated units in v3; not direct antigen detection.
not_a_measurement_of: time from infection to first division

EXHAUST.event: Set the binary exhausted flag and record its start time.
EXHAUST.eligible_state: Activated and not already exhausted; only lineages with permission.
EXHAUST.runtime_modifier: No numerical default is derived from the cited multistage functional assays.
EXHAUST.lattice: Set the abstract occupied-bin exhausted flag.

RECOVER.event: Clear the exhausted flag and its clock.
RECOVER.eligible_state: Exhausted units before the declared terminal duration; does not reset activation independently.
RECOVER.runtime_modifier: The duration cutoff is a separate assumed dynamics setting.

SECRETE.event: Add one abstract unit to the actor signal; T_reg uses suppressive_signal, other permitted lineages use signal.
SECRETE.eligible_state: Permitted living/occupied units; no activation or nonexhaustion gate is imposed for this action.
SECRETE.runtime_modifier: Decay and response to neighboring signals are independent runtime rules.
SECRETE.lattice: Add one signal unit per selected occupied-bin action, without occupancy scaling.
SECRETE.audit_output: Current commit logs do not emit a dedicated secretion event; selected actions remain in decisions.jsonl.

APOPTOSIS.event: Mark this agent dead at commit; a corpse remains until removal.
APOPTOSIS.eligible_state: Any living unit with the permission; transcript signature is a heuristic modifier.
APOPTOSIS.runtime_modifier: Death conflicts are resolved so a target is not counted dead twice.
APOPTOSIS.lattice: Empty the actor bin, losing its occupancy; not a single-cell death count.

KILL.event: Attempt death of one currently available licensed target.
KILL.eligible_state: can_kill permission, declared recognition, activated and nonexhausted actor, and a local living can_be_killed_target neighbor; current kill lineages are T_CD8 and NK.
KILL.runtime_modifier: Target availability/order and synchronous conflicts matter; spatial proximity is not measured CTL-target contact time.
KILL.lattice: Empty one eligible target bin regardless of fractional occupancy; not one killed cell.
not_a_measurement_of: NK killing rate from CTL papers

CLEAR_CORPSE.event: Remove one available neighboring dead cell-agent corpse.
CLEAR_CORPSE.eligible_state: can_clear permission and a local corpse.
CLEAR_CORPSE.runtime_modifier: Competing actions and target conflicts can reduce committed clearance.
CLEAR_CORPSE.lattice: Unavailable; bins do not leave cell corpses.

MOVE.event: Start or renew a stochastic moving episode.
MOVE.eligible_state: Motile lineage, spatial mode and enabled movement.
MOVE.runtime_modifier: Speed integrates over active episode hours; motion can continue on later steps without another MOVE selection.
MOVE.audit_output: move events count displacement segments, not necessarily episode starts.
